values.progress: Foundations poured for units 5 to 8. Drainage run on the north side finished and tested.
values.delays: Concrete arrived 90 minutes late; the second pour moved to tomorrow morning.

values.notes: Covered barriers, safe distances and where to cross. A question came up about the ramp by unit 6; it gets a handrail before Wednesday.

values.what-happened: A bundle of scaffold tubes slipped from the crane sling while being lowered. It landed inside the exclusion zone; nobody was near.
corrective-action: [x] Stop lifts until the slings are checked
[ ] Brief every crew on double slinging
[ ] Add the sling check to the morning lift plan

values.notes: Leaking hydraulic hose. The hire company is sending a fitter tomorrow; using unit 2 until then.

values.findings: Edge protection missing on one first-floor opening. Fire extinguisher by the site office out of date. Everything else in order.
actions: [x] Fit edge protection to the opening
[ ] Replace the extinguisher by the site office
